content: Devnet demonstration memory: preserve AI agent knowledge locally and anchor its cryptographic commitment to the Awareness Memory Registry on Solana.
title: Devnet demonstration: local memory privacy

knowledge_cards.title: Keep memory payloads local when anchoring knowledge
knowledge_cards.summary: This synthetic Devnet demonstration records a privacy rule: store memory text and private commitment witnesses in the local workspace, while publishing only cryptographic commitments and linked state roots to the Solana registry. An on-chain receipt proves an authorized submission, not the truth of the underlying memory.
